A pure due_trigger before production_evidence drops override-only triggers, breaking the contract's 'trigger

Rewrite the ticket to pick one resolution: (a) record bypass facts in the journal so measurements() counts override, and fence the code that writes and reads them; (b) state that override is no longer an unforced due trigger; or (c) define an evidence-loading fallback and when it runs.

If (b), add acceptance and tests for the override change and update any retro.spikes.kinds docs or config that list override. If (a), name the event that carries the bypass fact and the module that emits it, and fence both.

The branch already has an implementation (232425060 'Centralize retro due checks'). Keep its serve.py work (check_retro called only from the Serve.run loop) and the dis-based site test. Only the retro.py due-decision order depends on the premise fix.
